questions.text: What are the persistent data entities representing users, reports, locations, categories, states, state changes, internal notes, and notifications, and what are their primary relationships?
Which modules or components in the codebase own and encapsulate the persistence layer for municipal reports?
What are the allowed-to-use relations and package boundary crossings between the business logic and the persistence layer components?
Which specific types, classes, or ORM mappings implement the data entities and manage their lifecycle in the database?
What is the call chain and control flow when a municipal report's state changes or when internal notes and notifications are persisted?
